A '''special missions battalion''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A special missions battalion was the largest special mission formation within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], composed of four [[Special missions company|special missions companies]] and a [[battalion headquarters]]. The battalion numbered 746 men, supported by 88 [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. Unlike other battalion headquarters, special missions battalion command was expected to directly involved in combat operations. Support personnel were [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] who performed support operations once the situation had stabilized, the [[security platoon]] was staffed by experience [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and the command staff were combat veterans.<ref name="ISB" />

Special missions battalions could be augmented by the addition of four more special missions companies.<ref name="ISB2" />
